_what_this_is: The register of running and planned channel experiments. Every number a thread needs in order not to destroy an experiment lives here, not in prose. Read it with `py -3.11 scripts/pd_experiments.py`. Each entry validates against schemas/experiment.schema.json.
_why_this_exists: On 2026-08-12 a repackaging instruction was written that would have retitled 6 of the 13 control videos of a running experiment. It was caught by one agent reading one markdown file. The control list existed only inside a receipt's prose, so nothing mechanical could refuse the write. This file is that mechanism.
_rules: A number in this file is the only copy. If prose disagrees with it, this file wins.
locked_video_ids blocks writes. scripts/pd_experiments.py --check <id> exits 2 on a hit; apply_title_batch.py calls it before the first write.
read_on is a date, not an intention. scripts/pd_brief.py prints an experiment that is due.
Do not delete a completed experiment. Set status and fill result. The record of what was tried is the asset.

measured_baselines._note: Every figure below was measured, with the command or file that produced it. Do not re-derive these; do not quote a figure without its source.

long_form_thumbnail_impressions_28d.source: scripts/_yt_studio_video_ctr.20260819.json, summed over rows with length_seconds>=300 (68 rows). Window: YouTube Studio default trailing 28 days, file mtime 2026-08-19 22:38.

instrument_disagreement.values: 43973 (scripts/_yt_studio_ctr_summary.json) vs 64975 (per-video file, long-form only), both captured 2026-08-19 22:38

experiments.hypothesis: The 59-100 character Subject+Verb+Consequence title band, imported from Unseen (1.41M subs), raises PD's long-form CTR.
experiments.change: 39 back-catalogue titles rewritten 2026-08-10 ~23:55 JST via scripts/apply_title_batch.py.
experiments.primary_metric: paired delta CTR (VIDEO_THUMBNAIL_IMPRESSIONS_VTR), treated vs control, restricted to videos with >=150 before-impressions
confounders: Control skews low: treated holds 43923 before-impressions, control 12362. Expect regression to the mean to flatter the control.
The channel's four best titles (CTR 4.40 / 3.96 / 3.77 / 3.12%) are all inside the treated set.
PD's own data has already failed twice to show a title-shape effect (receipt section 5: treated +0.11pp, control -0.04pp, n=15/13).
experiments.stop_condition: read on 2026-09-07 (28 days, so the trailing window contains no pre-change impressions)

treated.note: 39 written; 30 of them are long-forms with >=150 before-impressions and form the treated arm.

title.reason: Retitling either arm before the read destroys the comparison.

thumbnail.reason: A thumbnail change moves CTR for a non-title reason and contaminates the arm it lands in.

verdicts.when: treated mean dCTR exceeds control by >= +0.30 pp
verdicts.then: keep the band in the spec and apply it to new episodes
retire the band as a HARD gate, keep it as a default, move the effort to thumbnails

verdicts.when: treated falls short of control by >= 0.30 pp
verdicts.then: roll back, starting with the four top performers

experiments.noise_floor_basis: the spread already seen among untouched controls between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-10 (-0.52 to +0.53)

experiments.hypothesis: The thumbnail, not the title, is the ceiling on PD's CTR.
experiments.change: Redraw the thumbnail and NOTHING else on 12 long-forms with >=150 before-impressions; 12 matched long-forms left untouched as control. Titles, descriptions and tags are not touched on either arm.
experiments.primary_metric: paired delta CTR (VIDEO_THUMBNAIL_IMPRESSIONS_VTR), treated vs control, restricted to videos with >=150 before-impressions
confounders: Cannot start before 2026-09-07 without contaminating title-band-2026-08-10.
Same low-n problem as the title experiment: only a large effect clears the 0.50 pp bar.
experiments.standing_evidence: Enok7A7wGBA (Police Raided the Wrong House) has a fully rule-compliant 62-character title, was deliberately left untouched, and went 0.45% CTR (2026-08-10) to 0.38% (2026-08-19). The title rules are satisfied and it is still the worst high-impression long-form on the channel.

verdicts.when: treated mean dCTR exceeds control by >= +0.50 pp
verdicts.then: thumbnails are the lever; move production effort there
the thumbnail is not the lever either. Stop spending on packaging and bet on external feed (see docs: pd-feeder-rail)

experiments.abort_condition: a treated video's CTR falls 0.50 pp or more below its own pre-change figure -- roll that thumbnail back and record it

experiments.owner_visible_name: long-form pace: 1 per day -> 2 per week
experiments.hypothesis: Publishing volume is not buying impressions. Fewer, better-packaged uploads will hold total impressions while raising impressions per upload.
experiments.change: Long-form publishing drops from daily (11 consecutive days 2026-08-12..08-22) to two per week.
confounders: Whether low-CTR uploads harm the channel as a whole is NOT MEASURED anywhere in this repository. This experiment does not test that.

verdicts.when: weekly impressions >= 16244 and impressions per upload at least doubled
weekly impressions fall more than 30% below baseline (< 11371)

experiments.hypothesis: PD's subject, not its craft, is the constraint. Disaster and system-failure topics have live external demand that police/court doctrine does not.
experiments.change: Publish EP72 lacmegantic, EP73 uri, EP74 itaewon, EP75 lahaina, EP76 morandi. All are already built or near-built; no new production is required.

supporting_measurement.demand_probe: episodes/_planning/measurements/TOPIC_DEMAND_PROBE_SLATE50_batch1-5.json (49 topics, measured 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-20): 36 of 49 have a competitor above 1,000,000 views; 12 of 49 have a video above 100,000 views published within the last 365 days.
supporting_measurement.pd_own_best: OceanGate (marQjsCagh0): 4806 impressions, CTR 3.14%, watch 38.8% -- first on the channel by watch-seconds per 1000 impressions (26459). The same topic tops the demand probe (titan submersible: median 1,028,373).
supporting_measurement.honesty: n=1. The channel's own record (docs/PD_EDITORIAL_DIRECTION.v002.md section 4) says OceanGate's margin may be carried by an external feed rather than by the topic. This experiment is how that becomes answerable.

confounders: The subject pivot already began around EP57; episodes published 2026-08-12..08-22 are already mixed-subject, so the police-vs-disaster contrast is not clean.
These five are also the longest episodes, so runtime and subject move together.

verdicts.then: the subject is the lever; commission the next slate from the demand probe
the disaster pivot is not working either. Abandon the topic hypothesis.

not_stopped_and_why.what: full visual QC of every footage clip and plate
not_stopped_and_why.why: EP65 marmet shipped with an identifiable real face in archive footage. Filename screening, pool QC and every machine gate passed it (docs/PD_CANON.md section 7, 20c). Automatic face detection is measured unusable (20d). Only reading the frames works, and a ban ends the business.

Of the 13 statistically readable long-forms, two are over 25 minutes (OceanGate 36 min, D.B. Cooper 29.7 min) and they rank 1st and 3rd by watch-seconds per 1000 impressions. n=2 is thin, but cutting the runtime now would cut the shape of the two best films. Reduce the NUMBER of episodes instead.
